TypeLeast：按一下，说话。再按一下，文字写到光标处。

## 本次更新 / What is new

<!-- typeleast-update:zh -->
- 常用按钮增加跟随鼠标的光影与按压回弹，侧栏图标有各自的短动作。
- 桌面待机语音条从三点平滑展开为声波和快捷键提示。
- 翻译圆点增加磨砂层次、渐变和高光，保留光环、鼠标跟随与点击回弹。
- 系统开启“减少动态效果”时减少运动反馈。
<!-- /typeleast-update -->

<!-- typeleast-update:en -->
- Common controls gain pointer-following highlights and press feedback; sidebar icons perform short individual motions.
- The idle voice bar smoothly unfolds from three dots into a waveform and shortcut hint.
- The translation dot gains a frosted finish, gradients, and highlights while retaining its orbit, pointer-following motion, and press response.
- Motion is reduced when the system Reduce Motion setting is enabled.
<!-- /typeleast-update -->

## 安装 / Installation

仅支持 macOS 14 及以上的 Apple 芯片 Mac。语音模型单独下载，Windows 与 Intel 版不再更新。本版调整外观和交互反馈，听写与翻译处理流程不变。

Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. Speech models are downloaded separately. Windows and Intel releases remain at their previous versions. This update changes appearance and interaction feedback; dictation and translation processing are unchanged.
